info.title: API.SH: Screener.in
info.description: The Screener.in API from API.SH: public Screener.in data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A company's chart series from Screener.in: price with 50- and 200-day averages and volume (with delivery percent), or P/E with median and EPS, margins, EV/EBITDA, price to book, or market cap to sales.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/screener-in-chart

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: NSE symbol or BSE code.

parameters.name: metrics
parameters.description: price (default), pe, margins, ev_ebitda, pbv or mcap_sales.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Days of history (default 365; up to 10000).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
An Indian listed company on Screener.in: name, NSE symbol and BSE code, sector path, index memberships, about and key points, key ratios (market cap, price, high/low, P/E, book value, dividend yield, ROCE, ROE ...), pros and cons, and the full tables: quarterly results, profit and loss, compounded sales/profit/price growth and ROE, balance sheet, cash flow, ratios history and shareholding pattern (quarterly and yearly). Consolidated by default. Also returns documents: recent exchange announcements (title, link, date, summary), annual reports (title, year, link, source), credit-rating reports (title, link, date, agency) and earnings-call documents per quarter (transcript, presentation, recording and notes links where listed).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/screener-in-company

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: NSE symbol (TCS, RELIANCE, INFY ...) or BSE code (500325).

parameters.name: standalone
parameters.description: true for standalone figures instead of consolidated.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Public stock screens on Screener.in. Without `screen`, the list of popular screens (id, name, description, link; 25 per page), or the ones matching `q` in their name or description. With `screen` (an id from the list, or a screens link), the screen's companies: name, symbol, link, CMP, P/E, market cap and every other column of that screen (key, label, unit and meaning per column), with the screen's name, description, author and query text. Companies are 25 per page; pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. Money figures are in Rs. crores.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/screener-in-screens

parameters.name: screen
parameters.description: Screen id such as 59 (Magic Formula), `id/slug`, or a screener.in/screens/... link. Leave out to list screens.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: List mode: only screens whose name or description contains this text, e.g. `dividend`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.name: Magic Formula
example.author: Sunil
example.query:
Return on invested capital > 25 and
Earnings yield > 15 and
Book value > 0 AND
Market Capitalization > 15
example.note: Money figures are in Rs. crores. Screens show 25 companies per page.

get.description:
A company's shareholding pattern by quarter or year (promoters, FIIs, DIIs, government, public, number of shareholders) and every named holder in each class with their stake in each period.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/screener-in-shareholding

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: NSE symbol, BSE code or a screener.in company link.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: quarterly (default) or yearly.

parameters.name: class
parameters.description: Only this holder class: promoters, foreign_institutions, domestic_institutions, government, public.

parameters.name: holders
parameters.description: false = classes only, without named holders.

parameters.name: standalone
parameters.description: true = standalone figures.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.name: Tata Consultancy Services Ltd
example.note: Percent of shares. holders lists every named holder Screener.in shows per class, with their stake in each period.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
